purpose.en: Replace SmartPay3 with SmartPay4 so a signed-in SmartLingo member can fund a course purchase from any connected wallet while the chain record still identifies the payer and product owner.
purpose.zh: 以 SmartPay4 取代 SmartPay3，使已登录 SmartLingo 会员可用任意连接钱包为课程付款，同时链上记录仍明确付款人与产品 Owner。

en: Every payment now carries the signed-in member PayerID and the permanent administrator product-owner RefID as separate six-character identities.
Account payment recovery reads the SmartPay4 transaction map by PayerID instead of requiring a saved profile wallet.
The administrator receives an immediate bilingual reminder when an Owner-only action is attempted from a wallet that is not the SmartPay4 Owner.
zh: 每笔付款现在分别携带已登录会员的六位 PayerID 与永久管理员产品 Owner 的六位 RefID。
账户付款恢复改为按 PayerID 读取 SmartPay4 交易映射，不再要求个人资料保存钱包。
管理员使用非 SmartPay4 Owner 钱包执行 Owner 专属操作时，会立即收到双语提醒。

en: SmartLingo's three supported three-month course products, twelve learning-language second IDs, Polygon payment administration, checkout, reconciliation, and account lookup are affected.
Card payments, course prices, existing SmartPay3 history, profile wallet editing, referrals, certificates, learning data, classrooms, header, footer, and branding are unchanged.
zh: 影响 SmartLingo 三个受支持的三个月课程产品、十二种学习语言 secondID、Polygon 付款管理、结账、核对与账户查询。
银行卡付款、课程价格、既有 SmartPay3 历史、个人资料钱包编辑、推荐、证书、学习数据、教室、页眉、页脚及品牌均不变。

en: Added the site-specific SmartPay4 contract, ABI, deployment artifact, public ABI route, PayerID transaction index, and separate contract-wide administrator read.
Removed SmartPay3 runtime contract, routes, styles, libraries, and public artifacts while retaining immutable migrations and historical provider compatibility.
Added a server-authoritative permanent-administrator product-owner resolver and required PayerID plus owner RefID during preparation, payment, receipt verification, claim, and synchronization.
Added migration 0178 for fresh SmartPay4 configuration and claims without copying the former SmartPay3 contract address.
Pinned the transitive XML parser used by document preview to the patched 0.8.15 release after the production dependency audit identified the newly reported 0.8.14 advisory.
zh: 新增站点专属 SmartPay4 合约、ABI、部署产物、公开 ABI 路由、PayerID 交易索引及独立的管理员全合约查询。
移除 SmartPay3 运行时合约、路由、样式、库及公开产物，同时保留不可变迁移与历史付款提供方兼容。
新增服务端权威的永久管理员产品 Owner 解析，并在准备、付款、收据验证、认领与同步全流程要求 PayerID 加 Owner RefID。
新增 0178 迁移，用于全新的 SmartPay4 配置与付款认领，且不会复制旧 SmartPay3 合约地址。
生产依赖审计发现新公布的 0.8.14 安全通告后，将文档预览间接使用的 XML 解析器锁定到已修复的 0.8.15。

en: The SmartPay4 Solidity contract compiled reproducibly with the reviewed artifact and passed mixed-token, single-token, identity, ownership, invalid-ID, and non-owner tests.

All focused payment, migration, multilingual interface, shared authentication, and site architecture contracts passed; TypeScript, zero-warning lint, D1 replay, and the production Worker build passed.
All 73 migrations applied exactly once in the local replay, no-op on the second run, and reported zero foreign-key violations.
zh: SmartPay4 Solidity 合约以已审核产物可重现编译，并通过混合代币、单代币、身份、所有权、无效 ID 与非 Owner 测试。
付款、迁移、多语言界面、共享身份验证及站点架构的专项合约均通过；TypeScript、零警告 lint、D1 回放与生产 Worker 构建均通过。
本地回放中 73 个迁移均只应用一次，第二次运行无操作，外键违规为零。

en: A new site-owned SmartPay4 contract must be deployed and configured by the administrator before live course-token payments resume; the user will perform the authenticated wallet acceptance test.
zh: 管理员必须先部署并配置新的站点专属 SmartPay4 合约，课程代币付款才会恢复；用户将执行登录态钱包验收测试。

en: SmartLingo keeps its three shared three-month price rules; the payment secondID remains the selected learning language and every course product's RefID remains the permanent administrator.
zh: SmartLingo 保留三个共享的三个月价格规则；付款 secondID 仍是所选学习语言，每个课程产品的 RefID 仍是永久管理员。

rollback.en: Restore the pre-release D1 snapshot and previous Worker together; existing SmartPay3 claims and purchase history remain retained for audit.
rollback.zh: 同时恢复发布前的 D1 快照与上一版 Worker；既有 SmartPay3 认领及购买历史仍保留用于审计。
